description: Many small features as icons with a name: tiles or chips in three to six columns.

files.content:
<!-- Code generated by packages/kit-compose/src/organisms.ts from packages/compose-gen/specs (compose-gen organism emitters on kit-compose). DO NOT EDIT. -->
<!--
  A dense grid of small tiles: an icon and a short label. Axes: columns (3, 4, 6), item (tile: icon above the
  label, chip: icon beside it), tone, density.
-->
<script lang="ts">
import type { Feature } from "./feature-grid.types";

export type IconWallProps = {
  id: string;
  title: string;
  features: Feature[];
  empty?: string;
  cols?: "3" | "4" | "6";
  item?: "tile" | "chip";
  tone?: "default" | "muted";
  density?: "default" | "compact";
  landmarkLabel?: string;
};
</script>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed } from "vue";
import Box from "../compose/Box.vue";
import Grid from "../compose/Grid.vue";
import LucideIcon from "../icons/LucideIcon.vue";
import Text from "../compose/Text.vue";
import EmptyState from "../components/empty-state.vue";
import SectionFrame from "../components/section-frame.vue";
import { cn, fitCols } from "../utils";

const {
  id,
  title,
  features,
  empty = "",
  cols = "4",
  item = "tile",
  tone = "default",
  density = "default",
  landmarkLabel,
} = defineProps<IconWallProps>();
const askedCols = computed(() =>
  ((item as string) === "chip") && ((cols as string) === "6") ? "2-6"
  : (cols as string) === "2" ? "2"
  : (cols as string) === "3" ? "2-3"
  : (cols as string) === "4" ? "2-4"
  : "3-6"
);
const wallCols = computed(() => fitCols(askedCols.value, (features?.length ?? 0)));
</script>

<template>
  <SectionFrame :id="id" :title="title" :tone="tone" :density="density" :landmarkLabel="landmarkLabel">
    <EmptyState v-if="((features?.length ?? 0) === 0)" icon="layout-grid" :title="empty" />
    <Grid v-else :cols="wallCols" class="gap-4" data-testid="items">
      <Box v-for="f in features" :key="f.id"
        :class="cn(
          'flex items-center gap-2',
          'rounded bg-card inset-ring inset-ring-border',
          (
            (item as string) === 'tile' ? cn('flex-col justify-center text-center', (((density as string) === 'compact') ? 'p-4' : 'p-6'))
            : 'px-4 py-2'
          )
        )"
        data-testid="item"
      >
        <LucideIcon :name="f.icon" :size="(((item as string) === 'tile') ? 24 : 16)" />
        <Text size="sm" weight="semibold">
          {{ f.title }}
        </Text>
      </Box>
    </Grid>
  </SectionFrame>
</template>
